jobs.name: [bot:vaultkeeper] vault-learn
jobs.prompt:
You are the vault agent. Daily vault learning + consolidation task:
1. Run the vault daily script: python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/vault-daily.py (or the copy in this profile scripts dir) and review its output.
2. Scan Daily/ notes from today and the past 2 days in /Users/admin/Documents/Obsidian Vault; extract durable facts, decisions, project states, and action items.
3. Update this profile's MEMORY.md (memories/) with what changed today — new facts, status changes, completed items. Keep entries concise and dated. Do not duplicate existing entries.
4. Check System/schema-lint-health.json if present; flag any schema regressions >1%.
5. End your reply with a brief "Learned today:" summary (3-6 bullets) so continuity chains your learning day over day.

jobs.name: [bot:vaultkeeper] vault-weekly-brief
jobs.prompt:
You are the vaultkeeper analyst. Produce the WEEKLY VAULT BRIEF. You are the NARRATOR, not the calculator: every number you publish must be copied VERBATIM from a file you read in THIS run. Never round, recompute, subtract, or qualify a figure as "approximately".

STEP 1 - read these files first (use read_file; vault root: /Users/admin/Documents/Obsidian Vault):
- System/schema-delta.json  <- THE metric source of record, pre-computed by schema-weekly-check.py. For every schema metric, copy its current/previous/delta values exactly as written. Do NOT read schema-lint-health.json or derive schema numbers from anything else.
- System/schema-trend.log   <- weekly compliance series (context only; on any conflict the delta file wins)
- /Users/admin/Documents/Obsidian Vault/System/vault-health.json (narrative status only)
- newest file matching: /Users/admin/Documents/Obsidian Vault/System/_generated/flywheel-health-*.md
- /Users/admin/.hermes/profiles/vaultkeeper/memories/MEMORY.md (just the most recent VAULT-LEARN sections)

STEP 2 - write the brief (markdown, 200-400 words) with sections:
- Schema health: quote compliance_pct and compliance_pct_previous straight from schema-delta.json, and copy the current/previous/delta triples for total_files and compliant exactly. If a previous value is null (first measured run), write "first measured run - no prior comparison" instead of inventing one. Reuse the verdict from the newest schema-trend.log line verbatim.
- Vault activity: narrative from MEMORY.md + vault-health.json (what happened, dated - no arithmetic)
- Flywheel: unprocessed backlog trend as described in the flywheel health file; quote any count verbatim and name its source file
- Risks & one concrete recommended action for next week

STEP 3 - save it with write_file as Knowledge/20-Reports/Vault-Weekly-Brief-YYYY-MM-DD.md (today's date) with frontmatter: type: report, created: today, domain: knowledge, status: shipped - plus wikilinks to the cited System/ files.

STEP 4 - reply with ONLY a 3-bullet TL;DR of the brief (this goes to Feishu).

Hard rules: schema metrics come ONLY from schema-delta.json, quoted verbatim and attributed as "per schema-delta.json". Numbers from other files must likewise be verbatim quotes with attribution - never computed. If schema-delta.json is missing or unreadable, state that in the brief and publish NO schema numbers rather than substituting another source. No tool calls = failed run.
